author: Blair Marnell
description:
House House's critically acclaimed co-op puzzle-solving game Big Walk has only been out for two days, but one modder is taking it upon themselves to add a new dimension to the gameplay.

Independent solo developer CircuitLord has announced that they are developing a VR mod for Big Walk. A brief demonstration of the mod was posted on social media as proof of concept.

CircuitLord subsequently posted a follow-up video that showed off the progress of the VR mod. In this iteration, the player's character can pick up objects and interact with them. But CircuitLord notes that it needs some refinement to make "thro
title: Another Way To Play Big Walk Is Already In The Works

author: Blair Marnell
description:
Two years ago, NPC Studio launched its farm life fantasy RPG Fields of Mistria into early access. Today, that preview period has officially ended with the 1.0 release of Fields of Mistria. A number of improvements have been added to the game with that update, including the ability to ride around the town of Mistria on a big chicken mount.

As part of the transition, previously incomplete quests like The Town Repair and The Museum can now be completed. Two new quests, Saturday Market Plaza and Repair the Bell Tower, have been added to the game, and players' Town Renown Cap has now been raised to 100, while the NPC Heart Level Cap has been raised to 10.
title: Fields Of Mistria Exits Beta With A Big Rideable Chicken

author: Claire Lewis
description:
I recently got my hands on Big Walk--an adorable "friendslop" puzzler from the minds behind Untitled Goose Game--and I can't seem to put it down. But when I do finally pry my fingers from the keyboard and log out of Steam for the night, I can't stop thinking about it, either. 

Something about Big Walk has been bothering me since I first laid eyes on it, but there's nothing wrong with the game itself. In fact, I'm with my colleague Mark Delaney on this one--Big Walk is one of the best co-op games ever, and it's also a game that's sort of difficult to define. Maybe that's why it's taken me so long to realize that what's been bothering me isn't the game itself, but the fact that it has been categorized as "friendslop." 

On paper,
title: The Friendslop Genre Needs A New Name

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
For the first time ever, a Halo game is available on PlayStation with Halo: Campaign Evolved. The game is having a "notably slow start" on Sony's console in terms of sales, however, according to gaming analyst Rhys Elliott.

He estimated that Campaign Evolved sold 351,000 copies on PS5 during July and 452,000 to date, generating nearly $28 million. By comparison, Elliott said Campaign Evolved has shifted 212,000 units on Steam and about 900,000 on Xbox across console and PC thus far.
title: Halo On PS5 Is Off To A Slow Start, Expert Says

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Minecraft is officially launching October 27 for Nintendo Switch 2, bringing with it what developer Mojang calls "Vibrant Visuals" as well as an upgrade path for original Switch owners.

While Minecraft has been playable on the Switch 2 thanks to backwards compatibility, the Switch 2 version will bring some improvements that take advantage of Nintendo's latest hardware. In a blog post, Mojang labeled the Switch 2 version's graphical improvements as a new "Vibrant Visuals" experience that will offer enhanced lighting, shadows, and more.

Not everything will support "Vibrant Visuals," according to Mojang. Playing in split-screen or using certain worlds or content from the marketplace will not feature the visual upgrades. One piece of
title: Minecraft Is Coming To Switch 2 In October, With An Upgrade Path For Switch Owners

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has teased that an Xbox version of PlayStation's Platinum trophy system could be coming to Xbox, and potentially soon.

Replying to a social media user who asked when Xbox might get an "equivalent" to Platinum for Xbox achievements, Sharma said, "Team is working on something for later this year!"

Platinum trophies are awarded when players unlock all the other trophies. It's a badge of honor, of sorts, for some people. There is no equivalent on Xbox currently for when people unlock all achievements.

While Xbox fan
title: Xbox Version Of PlayStation Platinum Trophy Teased For Later This Year

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Diablo 4 is reportedly headed to Nintendo Switch 2 this September, in what may be the first of multiple Diablo-related announcements coming as part of this year's BlizzCon.

As detailed by Dealabs reporter billbil-kun, game classification organizations in Indonesia and Taiwan both point towards a Switch 2 version of Diablo 4 existing, with Dealabs independently reporting a September 15 or 18 release date. The site also reports it will allegedly retail for $70 and receive a physical release, though it will only be a code in a box and not a physical cartridge.

What's currently unclear is whether or not Diablo 4 on Switch 2 will include both of the game's two expansions
title: We May Already Know One Major Diablo 4 BlizzCon Announcement

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The Ghost Recon franchise celebrates its 25th anniversary with a dedicated showcase on August 6, but it looks like one big surprise for this event has been leaked early. The PlayStation Store has seemingly let slip details on a big upgrade for 2017's Ghost Recon: Wildlands.

Spotted on the Ghost Recon subreddit, the PlayStation Store detailed a free current-gen upgrade that includes bumping the game's graphics up to 4K and 60fps, 3D audio support, faster load times via the console SSD, and extra haptic feedback features via the DualSense controller. A new "Last Rites" story pack will also reportedly go live with the update, and there'll also
title: Ghost Recon: Wildlands Might Finally Be Getting A Current-Gen Upgrade This Week

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
British actor Luke Dale, known for his roles in the Kingdom Come RPG series and EA's Battlefield V, has announced that he bought a tavern in the Czech Republic and plans to turn it into a medieval-inspired social gathering place with great food and drinks.

"Is this the dumbest thing I've ever done? There's a lot of competition for that title, but maybe," he said in a newly released video (via GamesRadar).

The tavern, which is called the Nobleman, is located in Vinohrady. It's
title: Kingdom Come Actor Is Living My Dream, Opening A Medieval Pub To Drink Beer And Eat Food With Friends

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Pokemon Pokopia’s new 2.0 update is live, and this introduces the ability to dive and explore underwater areas of the map. The Bubbly Basin paid expansion also includes dozens of new Pokemon to discover. In this guide, we'll highlight all of the new Pokemon added with Bubbly Basin and how to create their habitats.

You will be able to learn Pokopia's new dive mechanic as part of the free update, but you'll only be able to befriend the update's new water-themed Pokemon if you've purchased the paid DLC pass for access to Bubbly Basin.

title: All New Pokopia Bubbly Basin Pokemon And How To Unlock Them

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar owner Take-Two will release its next earnings report on August 7, but instead of coming after the market closes at 4 PM ET, the report is being released before it opens that day at 9:30 AM ET. Another unusual element is that the report is coming on a Friday. What does it all mean?

We don't know for sure, but one stock analyst said this setup suggests a major announcement about GTA 6 could come before
title: Why People Think GTA 6 News Is Coming Imminently

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
It looks like Marvel Rivals has been playing around with Pym Particles, as it's set to get much smaller on PC and console. As part of an update that will add super-evil supervillain manager The Hood to the game, developer NetEase announced that it has managed to shrink the install size by a considerable margin on PC and console.

According to the studio, a "massive texture compression overhaul" will see Marvel Rivals scale back by 40GB on PC, while PS5 and Xbox players will see the game reduced by up to 15GB. The current PC install size alone is 124GB, so this is quite the downsizing.

Creative director Guangyun Chen a
title: Marvel Rivals Is About To Give Your SSD Some Much-Needed Breathing Room

author: Callum Self
description:
There’s nothing more gratifying than slaughtering countless demons as the silent, formidable killing machine that is the Doomslayer. While the franchise is probably older than many of you reading, initially releasing in 1993, the recent reboots have brought back the brutal Doom Guy with all of the modern features we’ve come to know and love from the best FPS games. The latest entry, Doom: The Dark Ages, is everything you’d want from the series, and now it’s at its lowest price ever.

Doom 2016 played more like your traditional Doom experience, while its sequel, Eternal, had an almost Quake-like feel to it. Despite the heavy armor he wears, it’s surprising how swiftly the Doomslayer moves. Doom: The Dark Ages twists the formula ever so slightly, turning you into a walking tank with a c
title: Rip And Tear Into Doom: The Dark Ages At Its Lowest Price Ever

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The recently released ports of Call of Duty: Black Ops 1 and 2 for PlayStation sold more than 11 million combined copies, generating nearly half a billion dollars, according to industry analyst Rhys Elliott.

The games, which were developed by Iron Galaxy, were shadow-dropped on PS4 and PS5 on July 9, featuring campaign, multiplayer, and Zombies. The games were not remakes with improved graphics or new features, but instead "straight 1080p ports," as Elliott put it.

Technical experts found that the ports feature
title: Black Ops 1 And 2 Ports Sold 11 Million Copies Combined On PlayStation, Benefitting Both Xbox And Sony

author: Ben Janca
description:
Meet Loki Laufeyson, the God of Mischief and God of Lies! In this Character Guide, we cover his unpredictable toolkit so you can outsmart your rivals in every battle.

Learn about Loki’s illusion-based feints, counters, icy projectiles, magical attacks, and erratic movement. Dominate with his high-risk playstyle, which is built around confusing opponents and exploiting their bad habits to your advantage!

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PS5 and PC on August 6th, 2026 PT!
title: MARVEL Tokon: Fighting Souls – Official Loki Laufeyson Character Gameplay Guide

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Ironmouse's Sprite is now available to claim in Fortnite, but it seems there could be more on the way as the popular VTuber teased some further content for September.

On a recent stream, when asked about whether she would be releasing a Fortnite skin, Ironmouse said, "Just a Sprite today. Period." She shortly followed that up with, "That's all I'm going to say ... Also, do you guys know that I have a Subathon coming up in September and a lot of cool things are happening? I'm just saying, you know."
title: The Ironmouse Sprite Is Live Now In Fortnite, But It Seems There’s More To Come

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Beast of Reincarnation launched this week, and while the game does have several technical issues, co-developer Game Freak says that a patch is on the way. This will target several areas of the game, including bug fixes, improvements to the pacing of the game's story, and increasing the font size to something that doesn't require the Hubble Space Telescope to read. Game Freak says that it's aiming to release the patch next week.

One of the fixes will be for the game's camera, as many players have complained about it being too close to the protagonist Emma, making battles harder than they need to be. "Story pacing improvements" are also listed; increased text size is on the way, and the game's default gr
title: Beast Of Reincarnation’s First Patch Will Tackle Tiny Text And Broken Cameras

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
Journalism in 2026 is done almost entirely digitally, and information can be at practically anyone's fingertips in just a few seconds and a few taps on a phone screen. It wasn't always that way, however, and in Barkbyte Interactive's Static Hour, you venture to the 1980s to see how the limited technology of the era was used to report the news--and how it can be used to solve a spooky mystery.

Static Hour puts you in the shoes of an editor working the night shift at a news broadcaster. As the only one in the office, it's up to you to decide what's fit to broadcast, and it just so happens that a massive outbreak of violence has the public terrified.

To figu
title: Inform People, Or Scare Them Half To Death? Static Hour Gives You A Very Tough Job

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Pokemon Pokopia’s new 2.0 update is live, and this introduces the ability to dive and explore underwater. This new content also adds several new items to the game, including the highly requested shared storage system called the Portal Pod. In this guide, we'll explain how to unlock and craft the Portal Pod, so you can access items and materials with greater ease.

What is the Portal Pod?

Pokopia's 2.0 update adds the game's first shared storage item called the Portal Pod. This storage unit works similar to the Ender Chest in Minecraft or the Guild chest in Palworld. The Portal Pod lets you add or remove ite
title: Pokemon Pokopia – How To Unlock The Portal Pod And Store Shared Items

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Big Walk is here, and it's already earning a reputation for being a delightfully offbeat third space for friends to inhabit. It's a massive game, and as players have discovered, it does have a slight microphone problem currently--one that developer House House is working on fixing.

"We understand that some people are having a problem where their friends' voices are too quiet in the game. Sorry about this," House House wrote in a blog update. "While Big Walk is built around players getting quieter when they are farther away, we can see that for some setups, players' voices are much quieter than intended even when very close by. We're working to put out a fix as soon as we can."

There's no shortage of puzzles in Big Walk, and communication is the key to success. The game uses a feature where the
title: Big Walk’s Most Important Feature Is Getting Patched

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
The first of three paid DLC releases for Pokemon Pokopia has been released. In Bubbly Basin, you'll be able to venture underwater to a new town for Ditto to renovate. At the same time, the first free update for Pokopia has been released, which introduces the Dive mechanic and allows you to meet Manaphy.

There's far more than just the mechanic and the new town, though. Here's everything that's been added to Pokopia in the Bubbly Basin DLC and the free update.
title: Everything New In Pokemon Pokopia Bubbly Basin DLC And Free Update

author: Vic Hood
description:
In Phasmophobia, knowing how to escape or survive a ghost hunt is critical. While each contract requires you to identify a spectre based on official evidence and/or unique ghost abilities, the ghost won’t make it easy. Once your team’s average Sanity level reaches the ghost's specific hunt threshold (which can differ), the ghost will be able to hunt you and your squad, unless prevented by certain equipment, such as a Crucifix. 

If it catches you, it will kill you, rendering you an observer for the remainder of the contract, halving the precious rewards you
title: How To Escape A Ghost Hunt In Phasmophobia

description:
Pokemon Pokopia's new underwater expansion is now available, allowing you to learn how to dive and explore underwater. Diving is a free add-on for all players, but if you purchased the paid DLC for the brand-new underwater town, this guide will give you all the steps you need in order to dive down and reach Pokopia's new Bubbly Basin.
